# Rillmark

> Expressive React components. Editable source, Tailwind CSS 4, Radix primitives. Install individual items with the official shadcn CLI. No Rillmark runtime.

## Start here

- [Setup and install](./docs/getting-started.md): use this first; includes local serving and namespace configuration.
- [Foundations](./docs/foundations.md): tokens, dark mode, customization and accessibility.
- [AI setup](./docs/ai.md): consuming skill, shadcn MCP, progressive discovery.
- [Registry](./r/registry.json): searchable catalog.
- [Generated API](./api.json): exports and locally declared props from implementation.

## Components

- [Accordion](./docs/components/accordion.md): Detail when it is needed.
- [AlertDialog](./docs/components/alert-dialog.md): A deliberate pause before a consequence.
- [Alert](./docs/components/alert.md): Feedback with enough context to act.
- [Avatar](./docs/components/avatar.md): A recognizable presence, even without an image.
- [Badge](./docs/components/badge.md): A small, readable signal.
- [Breadcrumbs](./docs/components/breadcrumbs.md): A useful trail back.
- [ButtonGroup](./docs/components/button-group.md): Related actions, kept together.
- [Button](./docs/components/button.md): A clear next step, with quiet alternatives.
- [Card](./docs/components/card.md): A home for related information.
- [Checkbox](./docs/components/checkbox.md): An independent choice, clearly marked.
- [Combobox](./docs/components/combobox.md): Find a choice without losing your place.
- [Dialog](./docs/components/dialog.md): A focused task, with a clear way back.
- [DropdownMenu](./docs/components/dropdown-menu.md): Actions, right where they belong.
- [EmptyState](./docs/components/empty-state.md): A useful next step when there is nothing here.
- [Field](./docs/components/field.md): Labels, help and errors that stay connected.
- [IconButton](./docs/components/icon-button.md): A compact action with a name.
- [Input](./docs/components/input.md): A familiar place to begin.
- [Pagination](./docs/components/pagination.md): Move through a manageable set.
- [Popover](./docs/components/popover.md): Context within reach.
- [Progress](./docs/components/progress.md): A sense of how far along.
- [RadioGroup](./docs/components/radio-group.md): One choice from a visible set.
- [Select](./docs/components/select.md): A focused list of choices.
- [Separator](./docs/components/separator.md): A pause between related things.
- [Sheet](./docs/components/sheet.md): A little more room, alongside the work.
- [Skeleton](./docs/components/skeleton.md): A quiet placeholder for what comes next.
- [Slider](./docs/components/slider.md): Fine control across a range.
- [Switch](./docs/components/switch.md): An immediate on or off decision.
- [Table](./docs/components/table.md): Readable data, with room to grow.
- [Tabs](./docs/components/tabs.md): One workspace, several views.
- [Textarea](./docs/components/textarea.md): Room for a longer thought.
- [Toast](./docs/components/toast.md): An update that respects the current task.
- [Tooltip](./docs/components/tooltip.md): A short, optional explanation.

Read only the relevant component pages. Their examples compile as part of the site. Local edits are yours; use className and semantic CSS variables before adding variants.
